profile.headline: Software & IT Technician | C# / Python / C++ | Networking (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP) | Linux | Active Secret Clearance | Security+
profile.summary:
Active Secret Clearance (TS/SCI Eligible) | CompTIA Security+ | Bachelors Computer Science

Software engineer with hands-on experience developing and supporting production-critical systems in high-availability environments.

Currently working at Texas Instruments, where I design and develop automation tools, modify C# applications, and contribute to sprint-based development efforts while supporting system and network infrastructure.

My background combines software engineering with real-world systems experience:

• C#, Python, and object-oriented programming (with growing experience in C++)
• Development in Agile/sprint environments
• Debugging across software, networking, and system layers
• Linux and Windows systems support
• Networking: TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs

I began my career performing system and network operations (tool installation, environment setup, troubleshooting), and transitioned into software development—now contributing directly to production code and automation solutions.

Previously served in the U.S. Air Force, supporting mission-critical systems in secure environments under strict operational standards.

I bring a unique combination of software development, systems knowledge, and clearance, enabling me to work effectively in defense and aerospace environments.

Actively seeking opportunities in:
• Software Engineering  
• Systems Engineering  
• DevOps / Infrastructure  

B.S. Computer Science – Expected July 2026

positions.title: Software Engineer (Systems & Automation Focus)
positions.description:
• Developed and modified C# applications supporting production systems and manufacturing workflows  
• Built Python automation tools for log monitoring, anomaly detection, and system performance analysis  
• Transitioned from system and network support into Agile, sprint-based software development work  
• Performed debugging across software, networking, and system layers to resolve complex production issues  
• Supported Linux and Windows environments using scripting and command-line tools  
• Troubleshot network infrastructure including DNS, DHCP, and VLAN-related issues  
• Improved system reliability and reduced downtime through automation and root cause analysis

positions.title: IT / Systems Intern (Networking & Infrastructure)
positions.description:
• Supported installation, configuration, and deployment of tools and systems across enterprise network environments  
• Assisted in standing up and maintaining network-connected systems used in production environments  
• Troubleshot network and system issues involving DNS, DHCP, and connectivity  
• Worked in Linux and Windows environments using command-line tools and scripting

positions.title: Aerospace Ground Equipment
positions.description:
Aerospace Ground Equipment Technician
U.S. Air Force | 2019 – 2024

• Maintained and supported mission-critical systems in secure, high-tempo environments  
• Diagnosed and resolved system and network issues using structured troubleshooting methodologies  
• Improved system reliability and operational readiness through preventative maintenance  
• Operated under strict DoD safety, compliance, and security standards
